title: Dominant map from the reduced generic fibre
statement: In the affine setup of [lem-sbc-reduced-generic-fibre-field-embedding-core], after choosing the induced residue-field algebra structure on E, there exists a scheme-theoretically dominant map from Spec E to the eta-prime fibre of the reduction of the pullback, with the stated base composite.

proof.text: Use the induced residue-field algebra structure haE, he and hsquare to prove the scalar square. Apply the pullback universal property to the original field point j precomposed with Spec E → Spec L. Since the field source is reduced, its map kills the nilradical; lift through the reduction closed immersion and then to the fibre. The pullback equations prove both projection identities, including the stated base composite.

Transport the purely inseparable field extension along e. Its spectrum map is a universal homeomorphism. The comparison from the pullback fibre to the original fibre is a base change of that map. The reduction immersion is a surjective closed immersion, hence a universal homeomorphism, and the induced map of fibres is its base change. Their composite d is a homeomorphism.

The two projection identities imply h ≫ d = (Spec E → Spec L) ≫ j. The field spectrum map is surjective and j is dominant (affine maps are quasi-compact). Thus h ≫ d is dominant. Since d is a homeomorphism, h is dominant.

For an affine reduced source over an integral affine base, identify the residue field at the generic point with its function field, a fraction ring of its global sections. The affine fibre pushout is therefore a localization of the reduced source ring. This uses the affine-open form of the cited function-field theorem.

Reducedness survives localization at any multiplicative set: if (b/s)^n = 0 with n positive, then t*b^n = 0 for some denominator t; hence (t*b)^n = 0, so t*b = 0 in the reduced source and b/s = 0. Apply this to the reduced pullback. Mathlib IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isDominant then upgrades the already proved dominance of h into its reduced generic fibre.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0559, second proof; universal-homeomorphism route using Tags 01S4 and 04DF; reduced generic fibre by localization (Tag 030R). Lean proof by T4, 2026-10-14.

theorem exists_reduced_generic_fibre_map_core
    {Z S S' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Z] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S'] [IsIntegral S']
    (g : Z ⟶ S) (q : S' ⟶ S) (η : S) (η' : S') (hq : q η' = η)
    (hη' : IsGenericPoint η' Set.univ)
    (L k' E : Type u) [Field L] [Field k'] [Field E]
    [Algebra (S.residueField η) L] [Algebra (S.residueField η) k']
    [Algebra L E] [Algebra k' E]
    [Module.Finite (S.residueField η) k'] [IsPurelyInseparable (S.residueField η) k']
    (j : Spec (.of L) ⟶ g.fiber η) (hj : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant j)
    (hjbase : j ≫ g.fiberToSpecResidueField η =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField η) L)))
    (e : S'.residueField η' ≃+* k')
    (he : e.toRingHom.comp
      (((S.residueFieldCongr hq).inv ≫ q.residueFieldMap η').hom) =
        algebraMap (S.residueField η) k')
    (hsquare : (algebraMap k' E).comp (algebraMap (S.residueField η) k') =
      (algebraMap L E).comp (algebraMap (S.residueField η) L))
    (aE : Algebra (S'.residueField η') E)
    (haE : aE = ((algebraMap k' E).comp e.toRingHom).toAlgebra) :
    letI := aE
    ∃ h : Spec (.of E) ⟶
          ((pullback g q).nilradical.subschemeι ≫ pullback.snd g q).fiber η',
        IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant h ∧
        h ≫ ((pullback g q).nilradical.subschemeι ≫
          pullback.snd g q).fiberToSpecResidueField η' =
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S'.residueField η') E))
